score: Mean correlated gain versus the best held fixed allocation in each replica. Worst independent drift versus target-only. The known-law allocation and forecast are evaluator references.
method: Estimator fits both symmetric marginal rates and a finite dependence posterior from unlabeled calibration. It chooses a single allocation per cohort through expected reduction in Brier. The four nonoracle arms use the same calibrated predictor. Evaluator shares exogenous randomness, charges every policy-selected synthetic probe and charges the separately scored target outcome once. Held target outcomes never enter the fit. Frozen action budget and independent-drift requirements. Development simulator only.
